findings: Observed update RPC forwards the request to the internal handler. The payload contains deployer hash, code/layout data and layout proof; no owner signature or authorization nonce appears in that payload.

The observed handler compares existing deployer with the supplied deployer field, and checks shape, immutable height and layout proof. Hash equality does not by itself demonstrate caller possession or replay protection.

An authenticated transport/gateway layer may impose additional effective restrictions; its runtime source, endpoint coverage, config and rejection evidence have not been supplied. No assertion that remote deployment is exploitable is made.
Applications pin reviewed roots before proving/broadcast but lack atomic protocol version locking across a dependency upgrade.
requiredExternalAcceptance: Operations/security: identify effective middleware or gateway enforcement for psy_update_contract and any internal bypass endpoint. Supply source commit, digest and sanitized identity/role/endpoint config.

Protocol/security: demonstrate authorized owner-bound request plus unauthorized, substituted-owner, replay, wrong-domain and stale-old-layout rejection in a fresh isolated deployment; provide exact request and receipt hashes, no secrets.
Provide a protocol version-binding or governed upgrade guarantee covering the interval after application root checks; re-run full signature/session/fee/endpoints on new versions.
